description_id: Bundle skill + template Trade Pro v2.3. Briefing pasar pagi, alert saham + crypto, ringkas laporan keuangan emiten, plus IDR/BI rate watcher (pindahan dari Macro Strategist) + Bitget read-only (P1). v2.1 menambah template format briefing, schema alert, format earnings, dan rate-watch reference. v2.2 menambah playbook bitget-onboarding — alur 8 langkah memandu pemasangan API key Bitget dengan verifikasi scope read-only di sisi platform sebelum akses dibuka. v2.3 menambah 7 template disiplin trading: trading journal entry, position size calculator, exit plan, market analysis, sentiment analysis, weekly review, dan risk checklist — semua memperkuat risk-first DNA dan menggantikan improvisasi dengan struktur tertulis.

skills.description_id: Briefing pasar pagi jam 8 WIB — IDX open recap, US/EU overnight summary, crypto major moves, event calendar hari ini.
skills.description_en: Morning market briefing — IDX open, overnight US/EU, crypto top moves, today's event calendar.

skills.description_id: Set alert saham / crypto berdasarkan threshold (price, volume, news). Delivery via Telegram dengan one-line context. Tidak auto-trade.
skills.description_en: Watch stocks / crypto for threshold-based alerts (price, volume, news). Telegram delivery with one-line context. Never auto-trades.

skills.description_id: Ringkas laporan keuangan emiten — key metrics, surprises vs konsensus, audit notes, guidance change. Source dari laporan resmi (annual / quarterly).
skills.description_en: Summarize listed-company financial reports — key metrics, surprises vs consensus, audit notes, guidance change. Sourced from official annual/quarterly filings.

skills.description_id: Monitor IDR/USD dan BI rate. Update kalau IDR break level psikologis atau BI Board signal rate change. Konteks: spread vs Fed, capital flow, cadangan devisa. v2 — pindahan dari Macro Strategist.
skills.description_en: Monitor IDR/USD and BI rate. Updates on psychological-level breaks or BI Board signals. Context includes Fed spread, capital flow, foreign reserves. v2 — moved from Macro Strategist.

skills.description_id: Bitget integration read-only (P1). Customer pasang API key dengan read-only scope, aku surface portfolio snapshot, P&L, funding rate signal. Tidak execute trade. OAuth + execute scope di Phase 4.
skills.description_en: Bitget read-only integration (P1). Customer provides read-only API key; surface portfolio snapshot, P&L, funding rate. No trade execution. OAuth + execute scope deferred to Phase 4.

skills.description_id: Playbook 8 langkah memandu pemasangan API key Bitget dengan kontrak read-only. Akses surface bitget-readonly baru dibuka setelah scope key diverifikasi bersih lewat panggilan permissions Bitget. Gerbang keras langkah 7 menahan akses inline platform-side tanpa membuka baris approval — kalau scope keliru, customer regenerate key, paste ulang, dan verifikasi diulang sampai bersih.
skills.description_en: Eight-step playbook that walks customer through Bitget API key setup with a read-only contract. Access to the bitget-readonly surface unlocks only after the key's scope is verified clean via a Bitget permissions call. Step 7's hard gate rejects inline platform-side without opening an approval row — if scope is wrong, customer regenerates the key, re-pastes, and verification re-runs until clean.

skills.description_id: Generate template baru saat customer minta sesuatu yang belum ada di inventory. Pakai LLM customer (BYOK), simpan ke /var/lib/weuseai/customer-grown/.
skills.description_en: Generate a new template at runtime when the customer asks for something not in inventory.

templates.description_id: Struktur tetap briefing pasar pagi — IDX recap, overnight global, crypto, event calendar, sentiment one-liner.
Schema rule alert — ticker, asset class, condition, threshold, status. Disimpan append-only di alerts.jsonl.
Struktur tetap ringkasan laporan keuangan emiten — key metrics, surprises vs konsensus, catatan auditor, guidance change.
Reference IDR/BI rate — level psikologis IDR/USD, sumber data, dan framing per konteks customer (import, export, usd-debt, portfolio).

Template entry journal trading — satu trade per entry, append-only. Field: tanggal, instrument, arah, entry, exit, size, risk, thesis, hasil, plan-diikuti, pelajaran. Dipakai untuk catat trade closed dan lihat pola di 20-30 entry.

Worksheet sizing posisi sebelum entry — account size, risk per trade, entry, stop, dan formula deterministik (risk_amount / stop_distance). Output ukuran posisi yang terikat ke stop yang sudah di-set, bukan ke confidence.
templates.best_for: pre-trade position sizing tied to stop distance

templates.description_id: Exit plan wajib pre-entry — stop-loss + alasan, profit target (T1/T2) dengan aksi konkret, time-stop, scaling-out, dan R:R ratio. Stop tidak boleh digeser ke arah loss saat trade berjalan.
templates.best_for: pre-entry exit planning with stop + target + time-stop

templates.description_id: Analisis terstruktur satu instrumen atau market — tren, key levels, catalysts, setup, risk yang membatalkan thesis, confidence tag (high/moderate/low), dan source line. Bukan rekomendasi beli/jual.
Dashboard sentimen asset class atau pair — fear/greed, volume vs rata-rata, open interest, funding rate, social signal, interpretasi, bias, dan implikasi ke size + timing (bukan ke arah trade).
templates.best_for: sentiment snapshot informing sizing and timing, not direction

templates.description_id: Review mingguan trading — PnL, win rate, best trade (apa yang dilakukan benar), worst trade (apa yang bisa dipelajari), tema minggu, plan adherence, dan adjustments konkret untuk minggu depan.
templates.best_for: Friday or weekend reflection on process not just results

templates.description_id: Checklist pre-market daily — inventory posisi open, total exposure vs cap pribadi, korelasi antar posisi, kapital available, macro flags hari ini, self-rating emosional 1-5, dan decision rule (GO / REDUCED SIZE / NO TRADE TODAY).
